blurb: Guests can enjoy a variety of craft beers including year-round and rotating options, alongside a menu of pub fare such as burgers, tacos, and vegan bowls. The brewery offers brunch on weekends and lunch on weekdays, with happy hour specials and weekly events like trivia and bingo. Private and semi-private event rentals are available for groups up to 150 people.
